messages:
Morgan: FYI I opened PR #4821 that updates /infra/CODEOWNERS and touches services/model-serving/runtime-config.yaml. It adds a new wildcard owner entry for /services/model-serving/* and also bumps a kernel flag. Who is allowed to approve the CODEOWNERS change + runtime tweak?
Ash: Can you paste the exact CODEOWNERS change? wildcard owners can be sensitive. :eyes: 
Morgan: Sure — snippet:
```
# infra owners
/services/model-serving/* @eng-platform @model-team
/services/model-serving/runtime-config.yaml @eng-platform @infra-ops
```
Also changed: `runtime.kernel.use_optimized_attention: true` in runtime-config.yaml — that's the kernel flag.
Lee: That CODEOWNERS line will match new service dirs, but /services/model-serving/runtime-config.yaml explicitly lists @infra-ops which doesn't exist in our org (maybe old alias). Who is @infra-ops meant to be?
Carla: @eng-security should sign off on kernel toggles that could affect determinism or side-channel surface area. Also if this touches quantization/accel we need a short security review.
Ash: I'm fine approving the CODEOWNERS globs from a repo layout perspective, but I don't have context on kernel flags. Not my wheelhouse.
Morgan: OK — original author says @infra-ops was intended to be @eng-platform. I can update the PR to replace that. Question is: do we need both eng-platform and model-team approvals before merge, or can one cross-team approver suffice?
Lee: Per CODEOWNERS rules we need a valid approver for each matching pattern. If both teams are listed, GitHub will block merge until at least one required approver is present (org settings require CODEOWNER approval). We should check the repo's policy — sometimes we allow single-codeowner approval.
Sam (model-team): @Morgan I can review the model-serving runtime config side — can you add unit/integration tests that exercise the path? I’ll do a security-conscious pass but will need the tests.
Morgan: Yes tests are in the PR (unit + canary smoke). Linking: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4821
devops-bot: Reminder: merge window for risky infra/kernel changes is Tue 09:00–11:00 PT. If this touches runtime kernels, schedule accordingly.
sre-bot: Automated check: CODEOWNERS validation failed — unknown handle @infra-ops on line 12.
Morgan: Updated PR to replace @infra-ops -> @eng-platform and added a note in the PR description about the kernel risk and the canary plan.
Carla: Pinging @eng-security — please confirm if you need a formal review or a quick signoff.
Ash: Also pinging @platform-leads — if this is going to change perf profiles we should notify perf folks.
Sam (model-team): Reviewed the config diff. Left 2 small comments about timeouts and KV cache TTL. Once those are addressed + tests green I can approve. I don't need a second model-team approver.
Lee: I'll approve the CODEOWNERS change once the unknown handle is removed (which you did) and after a quick CI pass.
Carla: Eng-security: quick thumbs up here. Do we need an RCA-style blurb? If not, :thumbsup: from me.
Morgan: Thanks everyone — I'll address Sam's comments now. Plan to merge during Tue window after CI and canary pass. I'll add a merge-note linking security and perf pings.
Sam (model-team): Re-reviewed after changes — LGTM.
Ash: Approved.
Lee: Approved.
devops-bot: Scheduled merge for Tue 09:15 PT per merge window.
Morgan: Merged at 1958201899 after canary looked good. Thanks all!
